title: Agent Archivist status result (archivist.cli-result/v1)
description: The result document of the `status` command (plan Phase 5; CLI-015): the local collection status read from a read-only state snapshot while the daemon may own the mutator lock (CLI-007) — per-source counts by scheduling lane, the freshness of the last acknowledged capture, the live spool size, and the state layer's integrity verdict. Every figure is a content-free counter or a closed-vocabulary token; no field carries a path, a transcript body, a secret value or reference string, or an unbounded identifier (SEC-004, CFG-027).

x-archivist.compatibility: member additions are additive within v1 per plan Section 7.1 (CLI-015); redefining or removing a member, or a new namespace, is a v2 event

schema.description: The CLI result namespace. Present in every result document so a consumer always knows which contract it is reading before anything else (VAL-001); an unknown namespace is not this format and fails closed.

generated_at.description: The instant the snapshot was read (plan Section 7.3).

state.description: The state database's recorded schema version and the read-only integrity verdict.

sources.description: Per-source counts by scheduling lane, from the state snapshot.

spool.description: The live spool: the not-yet-acknowledged byte sum the state database records.

last_capture_at.description: The freshest acknowledged capture instant across all sources, or null when nothing has been captured yet — the freshness evidence a consumer compares against its own clock.

schema_version.description: The applied schema migration version; 0 before any migration.

integrity.description: The read-only integrity verdict over the automated checks (store integrity, foreign keys, expected schema objects).

state-verdict.description: The state layer's version and integrity verdict.

source-counts.description: Enrolled source counts by scheduling lane.

live_bytes.description: Bytes of not-yet-acknowledged spool bundles the state database records. The high-water policy's limits are the caller's configuration; this figure is the measurement.
